# ssutil

**ssutil** is an R package providing a suite of tools for sample size
estimation and power simulation in a variety of clinical trial designs.
It includes methods for binomial, normal, and negative binomial
endpoints, as well as support for equivalence and non-inferiority
testing scenarios. It also includes functionality for power and sample
size calculation for selecting the best group using the
indifference-zone approach for normal and binomial outcomes.

## Features

- Empirical power simulation for:
  - Binomial, normal, and negative binomial endpoints
  - Equivalence and non-inferiority designs
  - Best group selection using the indifference-zone approach for normal
    and binomial outcomes
- Sample size utilities for various design types

## Installation

``` r

# Install from GitHub (requires remotes or devtools)
remotes::install_github("johnaponte/ssutil")
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`empirical_power_result()`](https://johnaponte.github.io/ssutil/reference/empirical_power_result.md)
  : Create an Empirical Power Result object
- [`format(`*`<power_events_rate>`*`)`](https://johnaponte.github.io/ssutil/reference/format.power_events_rate.md)
  : Format method for power_events_rate class
- [`format(`*`<power_single_rate>`*`)`](https://johnaponte.github.io/ssutil/reference/format.power_single_rate.md)
  : Format method for power_single_rate class
- [`is.empirical_power_result()`](https://johnaponte.github.io/ssutil/reference/is.empirical_power_result.md)
  : Check if an object is a sim_power_result
- [`multp()`](https://johnaponte.github.io/ssutil/reference/multp.md) :
  Calculate the Multivariate Normal Probability
- [`multz()`](https://johnaponte.github.io/ssutil/reference/multz.md) :
  Calculate the Upper Equicoordinate Point of a Multivariate Normal
  Distribution
- [`power_best_binomial()`](https://johnaponte.github.io/ssutil/reference/power_best_binomial.md)
  : Power to Correctly Select the Best Group in a Binomial Test
- [`power_best_normal()`](https://johnaponte.github.io/ssutil/reference/power_best_normal.md)
  : Power calculation for the Indifferent-zone approach for normal
  outcomes
- [`power_events_rate()`](https://johnaponte.github.io/ssutil/reference/power_events_rate.md)
  : Probability of Observing At Least a Given Number of Events
- [`power_single_rate()`](https://johnaponte.github.io/ssutil/reference/power_single_rate.md)
  : Detectable Event Rate with Specified Power and Sample Size
- [`print(`*`<empirical_power_result>`*`)`](https://johnaponte.github.io/ssutil/reference/print.empirical_power_result.md)
  : Print method for empirical_power_result
- [`print(`*`<power_events_rate>`*`)`](https://johnaponte.github.io/ssutil/reference/print.power_events_rate.md)
  : Print method for class power_events_rate
- [`print(`*`<power_single_rate>`*`)`](https://johnaponte.github.io/ssutil/reference/print.power_single_rate.md)
  : Print method for class power_single_rate
- [`prophr()`](https://johnaponte.github.io/ssutil/reference/prophr.md)
  : Calculate Event Probability in the Experimental Group Given a Hazard
  Ratio
- [`sim_power_best_bin_rank()`](https://johnaponte.github.io/ssutil/reference/sim_power_best_bin_rank.md)
  : Simulate Power to Rank the Best Group Using Binomial Outcomes
- [`sim_power_best_binomial()`](https://johnaponte.github.io/ssutil/reference/sim_power_best_binomial.md)
  : Simulate Power to Select the Best Group Using Binomial Outcomes
- [`sim_power_best_norm_rank()`](https://johnaponte.github.io/ssutil/reference/sim_power_best_norm_rank.md)
  : Simulate Power to Select Best Group by Ranks (Normal Outcomes)
- [`sim_power_best_normal()`](https://johnaponte.github.io/ssutil/reference/sim_power_best_normal.md)
  : Simulate Power to Select Best Group (Normal Outcomes)
- [`sim_power_equivalence_normal()`](https://johnaponte.github.io/ssutil/reference/sim_power_equivalence_normal.md)
  : Empirical Power for Equivalence (Normal Outcomes)
- [`sim_power_nbinom()`](https://johnaponte.github.io/ssutil/reference/sim_power_nbinom.md)
  : Empirical Power for Negative Binomial Comparison
- [`sim_power_ni_normal()`](https://johnaponte.github.io/ssutil/reference/sim_power_ni_normal.md)
  : Empirical Power for Non-Inferiority (Normal Outcomes)
- [`ss_best_binomial()`](https://johnaponte.github.io/ssutil/reference/ss_best_binomial.md)
  : Sample Size to Select the Best Group in a Binomial Test
- [`ss_best_normal()`](https://johnaponte.github.io/ssutil/reference/ss_best_normal.md)
  : Sample Size for Selecting the Best Treatment in a Normal Response
  (Indifference-Zone)
- [`ss_ni_ve()`](https://johnaponte.github.io/ssutil/reference/ss_ni_ve.md)
  : Sample Size and Non-Inferiority Margin for Vaccine Efficacy Trials
- [`tidy(`*`<empirical_power_result>`*`)`](https://johnaponte.github.io/ssutil/reference/tidy.empirical_power_result.md)
  : Tidy Method for empirical_power_result
- [`wcs_power_best_binomial()`](https://johnaponte.github.io/ssutil/reference/wcs_power_best_binomial.md)
  : Worst‐Case Scenario Power for the Best Binomial Group
